title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.


A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.


More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Fund Manager
description:
Fund Operations Manager (AMIF)

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - On site

Company: Amicorp Fund Services


Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.


About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.


Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.


✨ Ready to elevate your career and lead with impact?

Apply now and become part of Amicorp’s global success sto

title: Consultor/a em Administração Contratual (Contrato Temporário)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Consultor/a em Administração Contratual para atuar em sob contrato temporário e regime híbrido em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio Grande do Sul/RS . Este/a profissional garantirá a correta gestão dos contratos em projetos de construção civil, assegurando conformidade legal, mitigação de riscos e maximização de resultados financeiros , tendo estas principais atribuições:


  • Analisar e interpretar contratos de obras e serviços, identificando riscos e oportunidades;
  • Acompanhar a execução contratual, propondo medidas corretivas e preventivas;
  • Elaborar notificações, aditivos, termos de encerramento e demais documentos contratuais;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de obras na gestão de escopo, prazos, custos e compliance contratual;
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes, fornecedores e subcontratados para alinhamento contratual;
  • Realizar interface com o jurídico para suporte em disputas, mediações e arbitragens;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e legais, incluindo cláusulas de compliance, seguros, garantias e licenças;
  • Utilizar corretamente a documentação que integra a concorrência (carta convite, edital de licitação, perguntas/consultas, leis de contratação pública, etc.) durante a etapa de conquista;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de todos os deveres e obrigações contratuais, com amplo domínio dos documentos envolvidos (contrato, proposta técnica/econômica, aditivos, leis, normas, seguros e fianças);
  • Elaborar, em conjunto com outras áreas, documentação contratual robusta (cartas, e-mails, diários de obra, relatórios, cronogramas, etc.), respeitando os parâmetros e prazos contratuais e mantendo o arquivo do projeto organizado;
  • Quando cabível, elaborar e sustentar reivindicações (claims) e aditivos junto ao cliente, preservando o equilíbrio contratual.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Contratos, Direito Contratual ou Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Experiência em projetos de infraestrutura pesada e/ou obras industriais na área de Administração Contratual;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos da Legislação aplicável (Lei de Licitações, Contratos Privados, Normas Técnicas);
  • Forte habilidade de negociação, comunicação clara e visão analítica;
  • Dominar as diversas estruturas de modalidades contratuais utilizadas nos mercados mais competitivos mundialmente (Preços Unitários, preço global, LSTK, Aliança, EPCM, entre outros.
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar sob contrato temporário, em regime híbrido, na região do Rio Grande do Sul/RS



Sobre a Odebrecht :


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura :


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players . Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and other international markets.

We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. If you are eager to learn, unafraid of challenges, and ready to grow with a like-minded team — we want to hear from you.


Role


As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and deployment of products that help companies engage with their customers in efficient and personal ways.

Our technology stack is built in Scala, NodeJS, and Ruby on Rails, running on Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Kafka. We containerize and deploy with Kubernetes on AWS. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


O que você deve ter?

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (6 Month FTC)
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

Please note this is a 6-month fixed-term contract role.


The Opportunity

Are you passionate about recruiting top talent for Tech and Product roles? Join our global business at Cint as a Talent Acquisition Partner, where you will support our R&D (Tech and Product) teams. Our Talent Acquisition (TA) function is critical to our success, as it enables us to attract and hire the right talent that drives our business forward. In this role, you will proactively manage the recruitment process, working closely with business leaders to attract and hire the best candidates for our commercial and finance functions.


The Team

You will be part of an established global TA team comprising both technical and non-technical recruiters. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, where we support one another, share information, and celebrate successes. We continuously evaluate and improve our processes to ensure we remain at the forefront of talent acquisition.

Join us at Cint and be a part of a dynamic team that plays a vital role in our global success. If you are ready to take on the challenge and drive the recruitment of top technical talent, apply now!


What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead and execute the entire recruitment process for roles within our Tech and Product functions.
  • Consultative Partnership: Work closely with hiring managers, People Partners, and Finance Partners to share industry trends, compensation insights, and competitor updates.
  • Educate Hiring Managers: Provide guidance on best practices, recruitment strategies, and process improvements to enhance their hiring practices.
  • End-to-End Process Management: Manage all aspects of the hiring process, including writing job advertisements, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, arranging interviews, and extending job offers.
  • ATS Management: Maintain and update our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) – SmartRecruiters.
  • Support DEI: Promote and support Cint’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Engage in projects with the TA team to implement process changes that enhance our ability to identify and attract talent.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Analyze your performance metrics to identify strengths and areas for development, and share these insights with the team.
Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: Proven experience in a talent acquisition/recruiting role, managing end-to-end recruitment for commercial vacancies in Brazil/North America.
  • Commercial & Finance Insight: Understanding the importance of the Tech/Engineering and Product functions within a global business.
  • ATS Proficiency: Ability to maintain and manage an accurate ATS.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Ability to analyze performance metrics and use data to drive recruitment strategies.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong team player who can collaborate effectively to address challenges and develop solutions.
  • Proactive Sourcing: Willingness to source candidates proactively to find the right expertise.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • ATS Experience: Previous experience using the Smart Recruiters ATS.
Additional Information


Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (

title: Analista de Riscos e Seguros
description:
Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Somos uma consultoria que une inteligência de riscos e soluções em seguros com o propósito de proteger empresas e pessoas em um mundo que se renova a cada instante. Em nossa trajetória de mais de 45 anos atuando em projetos de alta complexidade, o que nos move são os desafios de nossos clientes e a convicção de que podemos atuar diretamente na transformação de incertezas em oportunidades por meio da criação de soluções sob medida, qualificadas e inovadoras. Quer nos conhecer melhor?

Acesse: e saiba mais sobre nossa atuação e Nossa Cultura .


Buscamos um/a Analista de Riscos e Seguros que atuará na gestão de riscos e corretagem de seguros dos nossos clientes LATAM dos segmentos de Infraestrutura e do mercado de Energia.


✅ Os interessados podem se candidatar aqui, por meio desta vaga em nosso LinkedIn.

✅ Conhece alguém com este perfil? Compartilhe esta oportunidade.


Na Horiens, este/a profissional será responsável por apoiar os processos de gestão de riscos, definir e implementar as estratégias de transferência dos riscos seguráveis (na íntegra dos processos de corretagem de seguros, como colocação, inspeção de riscos e regulação de sinistros), buscando viabilizar a melhor relação custo-benefício para os clientes, tendo estas atividades principais:


  • Realizar as análises dos riscos contratuais de modo a garantir a correta alocação dos riscos entre os stakeholders envolvidos;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os programas de seguros de cada cliente e definir suas estratégias de contratação, de forma a garantir que estejam de acordo com as necessidades;
  • Elaborar orçamentos de seguros para os clientes a partir da análise dos riscos identificados e seguráveis, considerando o cenário do mercado (res)segurador e a melhor relação entre custo e coberturas securitárias;
  • Programar e participar das inspeções de risco, acompanhando a implementação das recomendações feitas e as eventuais alterações do risco que possam impactar o programa de seguros contratado;
  • Manter atualizados os sistemas da Horiens com as apólices de seguros negociadas, de forma a garantir o arquivamento adequado dos dados das transações realizadas ao longo do período de vigência.


Para este desafio conosco gostaríamos do seguinte perfil:

  • Experiência anterior como Analista de Riscos e Seguros
  • Formação Superior completa preferencialmente nos ramos da Engenharia, Administração ou Direito
  • Idiomas: inglês e espanhol fluentes
  • Sólidos conhecimentos sobre processos de colocação de (res)seguro, assim como sobre a atuação do mercado ressegurador
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe


Diferenciais:

  • Cursos e / ou certificações técnicas em (res)seguros e gestão de riscos
  • Cursos e / ou certificações do mercado de Energia


Conheça alguns dos benefícios que oferecemos para você e sua família:

  • Jornada de trabalho flexível e em modelo híbrido (3x2)
  • Plano de Previdência Privada para você atuar hoje no seu futuro

  • Auxílio creche mensal (até 12 meses)
  • Diversas parcerias e convênios que oferecem descontos em serviços e produtos

About Us

Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.


We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.


Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!


Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.


Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.


We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:


  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.


Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!


What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.


Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.


Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).


Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.


Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.


Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!


Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.


We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa com times multidisciplinares

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world’s leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called “Cognoids,” take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their ‘Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast’ culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.


Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager’s territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.


Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

title: Analista Supply Chain
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.


Objetivo do Cargo:


O(a) Analista de Supply III será responsável por liderar iniciativas em toda a cadeia de Procure-to-Pay dentro do setor de Oil & Gas, garantindo processos de aquisição eficientes, compliance regulatório e geração de valor por meio da negociação, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e identificação de oportunidades de savings. Atuará de forma transversal, conectando-se com clientes internos, auditoria, análise de custos e estratégia de suprimentos, com foco em excelência operacional, sustentabilidade da cadeia e alinhamento às metas organizacionais.



Responsabilidades


Procura & Negociação:


  • Liderar processos de Procura para categorias definidas, conduzindo análises de mercado, RFPs, RFQs e negociações complexas, incluindo elaboração de Ordens de Compra de acordo com os termos e condições acordados.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, garantindo performance, entregas no prazo, inovação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de savings, por meio da análise de gastos, otimizando custos e promovendo eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Implementar contratos e SLAs alinhados às políticas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio.


Análise & Gestão de Performance:


  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.
  • Gerenciar dados de procura e gastos, identificando tendências, oportunidades de savings e alavancas de negociação.
  • Garantir a qualidade das informações em sistemas de gestão (ERP, tracking e dashboards de performance).
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.


Stakeholder Management & Comunicação:


  • Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas clientes para definição de prioridades e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Fornecer suporte em processos de auditoria externa e interna relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos.


Liderança & Desenvolvimento:


  • Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.
  • Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.



Requisitos


Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement ou Supply Chain dentro do setor de Oil & Gás.
  • Forte conhecimento em negociação, gestão de contratos e análise financeira.
  • Domínio de ERP (preferencialmente JDE ou Oracle) e ferramentas analíticas (Excel avançado, Power BI).
  • Inglês fluente.



Desejáveis:


  • Certificações (CPSM, CSCP, CFA ou similares).
  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
  • Vivência em empresas globais e ambientes multiculturais.
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de estoques.



Competências & Habilidades:


  • Visão estratégica aliada à execução tática.
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Habilidade de negociação e influência em diferentes níveis.
  • Organização, gestão de múltiplas prioridades e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Comunicação clara, assertiva e foco em relacionamento colaborativo.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão.

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.


Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

A posição de Consultor(a) de Presidência tem como principal missão apoiar diretamente o(a) CEO na agenda estratégica, institucional e de governança da companhia, contribuindo para o desdobramento e acompanhamento dos principais pilares do plano estratégico, garantindo fluidez na tomada de decisões e na interlocução com os principais stakeholders da organização, incluindo o acionista francês.

Esse(a) profissional atua de forma transversal, com visão crítica de negócio, elevada capacidade analítica e excelente habilidade de comunicação executiva. É esperado que tenha autonomia e senioridade para representar a presidência em fóruns internos, apoiar o alinhamento entre as áreas da companhia, coordenar entregas estratégicas e apoiar a construção de visões integradas sobre o desempenho da organização.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar a presidência na consolidação da agenda estratégica da companhia, atuando como facilitador entre os objetivos corporativos e os principais desdobramentos executivos;
  • Preparar materiais executivos para conselhos, comitês e reuniões de acompanhamento estratégico, garantindo alinhamento institucional e consistência da informação;
  • Coordenar, junto à alta liderança, a governança de projetos estruturantes, assegurando visibilidade, integração e aderência aos objetivos do negócio;
  • Participar ativamente das interlocuções com o acionista estrangeiro, contribuindo com insumos estratégicos, apresentações e análises sobre a operação e seus resultados;
  • Monitorar os principais indicadores estratégicos da companhia, propondo leituras executivas, análises de sensibilidade e alertas para tomada de decisão;
  • Garantir uma visão integrada das informações gerenciais, consolidando dados de diversas áreas em diagnósticos estratégicos e dashboards de performance;
  • Atuar como braço estendido da presidência em iniciativas corporativas de alto impacto, com capacidade de articulação e influência junto a stakeholders internos e externos;
  • Apoiar a presidência em temas institucionais, regulatórios ou de relacionamento com entidades do setor e órgãos externos, quando necessário.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Profissional com sólida experiência em consultoria estratégica, planejamento corporativo, relações institucionais ou apoio executivo a alta liderança (Presidência, Diretoria Executiva, Conselho);
  • Forte capacidade de articulação, influência e navegação em ambientes complexos e multifuncionais;
  • Visão crítica, foco em resultado e capacidade de síntese para construção de mensagens executivas de alto impacto;
  • Domínio na elaboração de apresentações estratégicas com rigor lógico, clareza visual e conteúdo orientado a decisão;
  • Inglês (obrigatório) e Francês (desejável), com experiência em ambientes de atuação internacional ou com interlocução com matriz no exterior;
  • Formação superior completa, com pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas como Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Relações Internacionais ou similares;
  • Desejável vivência no setor de seguros, financeiro ou em empresas com forte estrutura de governança.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido (3x escritório) no escritório da Berrini.

title: Analista de controladoria sênior (FP&A)
description:
Sobre nós


Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.


Como é atuar conosco


Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.


Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes.

Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Apresentar mensalmente os indicadores de performance da empresa, incluindo Receita, Custo por projeto, Margem, Despesas, EBIT e PBT, de forma consolidada e comparativa (real x forecast);
  • Elaborar e manter atualizadas planilhas de acompanhamento gerencial, assegurando a consistência das informações e a integração com os relatórios da matriz;
  • Apoiar na consolidação e análise das projeções financeiras e orçamentárias mensais;
  • Participar da elaboração de budgets e forecasts, alinhando as premissas com as áreas de negócio;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos e templates estabelecidos pela matriz para reportes mensais;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de controle e performance financeira;
  • Interagir com os times de Contabilidade, Financeiro e Controladoria, promovendo o alinhamento de informações e a acuracidade dos dados;
  • Preparar relatórios analíticos e apresentações gerenciais com insights financeiros para suporte à tomada de decisão.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em controladoria, FP&A ou contabilidade gerencial;
  • Conhecimento de análise de indicadores financeiros e orçamentários (budget, forecast, variações);
  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de reporte (como Hyperion, Power BI ou similares);
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e traduzir em informações gerenciais;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação para interação com a matriz;
  • Desejável experiência em ambiente corporativo multinacional;
  • Inglês avançado obrigatório.


O que esperamos de você


  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
  • Disposição para colaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos;


Benefícios


  • Rede de academias;
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Director of Accounting
description:
Job Title: Financial Controller, Brazil (Director of Accounting)


About SHEIN:

Are you looking for an exciting new move in your career? SHEIN is an international online fashion retailer that’s in an exciting new phase of our continued growth! If you like to work fast, collaboratively and understand the true value of idea generation with a ‘customer first’ mentality - you’re on your way to being a right fit for us. SHEIN prides itself on our agility within our business model and talent base so we’re looking for dreamers and doers. As a fast-growing business with an immediate need to innovatively build out our talent infrastructure, we’re looking for a dynamic professional who is keen to work in an agile and evolving business environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support business growth of the company from a financial control perspective
  • Ensure financial reporting and practices are in line with statutory law and corporate control procedures
  • Adherence to US GAAP and local statutory accounting standards, delegated authority matrix and various policies and assess control risk as necessary
  • Provide expert analysis and evaluations on financial, accounting, planning & forecasting and cost in order to improve the results of the organization
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of the tax returns through proper supervision and review
  • Maintain effective internal control system and liaise with external and internal auditors on improvement of internal control procedures
  • Perform local treasury - cash management and forecasting.
  • Ensure the consistency of financial processes and procedures, and continuously optimizes to gain efficiency.


Job Requirements

  • At least 15 years of working experience in Finance with a minimum of 5 years' experience managing a team
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, Fluent in Chinese is a plus, but not required
  • University graduate or above in accounting or finance related discipline, a CPC/CPA/CMA/ACCA or equivalent qualification is a must.
  • Experienced and energetic finance professional with a passion to make a difference
  • Has a strong business, analytical, operational and leadership mind-set
  • A true team player with very good communication and people skills
  • Able to establish relationships and work cooperatively across boundaries and the matrix to achieve results.
  • Ability to effectively navigate and influence senior management and partner organizations.
  • Develop self, peers and direct reports.
  • Builds and invests in a diverse, high-performing team.
  • Able to collaborate and communicate effectively within cross-functional teams and resolve complex problems positively.


At Shein, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30-45k BRL


Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.


Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.


Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  1. Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  2. Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  3. System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  4. Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  5. Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  6. Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.


Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

title: Executivo de Vendas Inside Sales
description:
Na ADP somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Congratulamo-nos com suas ideias sobre como fazer as coisas de forma diferente e melhor. Em seus esforços para alcançar, aprender e crescer, apoiamos você todo o caminho. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence ao ADP.


Nós nos esforçamos para que todas as interações sejam conduzidas por nossos valores CORE: Perícia perspicaz, integridade é tudo, excelência em serviços, inovação inspiradora, cada pessoa conta, orientada por resultados e responsabilidade social.


Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer.


Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.


Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!!!



Resumo da posição


O executivo de Inside Sales é responsável por gerenciar as carteiras de clientes ativos e potenciais, desde a prospecção até o pós-venda, ofertando soluções para otimizar a produtividade do departamento de Recursos Humanos das empresas de até 250 funcionários.

  • Vendas consultivas de soluções de HCM (Human Capital Management) baseadas em nuvem (SaaS/BPO);
  • Expertise de negociação com foco em executivos de RH, CFOs, CIOs e CEOs;
  • Desenvolvimento de todo o ciclo de Vendas: Prospecção, Levantamento de Processos, Avaliação de Necessidades, Elaboração de Propostas e Apresentações de Projetos;
  • Negociação de todos os aspectos do projeto (custos, jurídico, prazos e implantação) até o fechamento do contrato;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias para superação das metas de vendas em território designado;
  • Gerenciamento de Pipeline e apresentação de Forecast semanal.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, apresentações e negociação.
  • Características como dinamismo, perfil pró-aprendizagem e alta energia.

O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana


“Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

title: SDR Outbound
description:
Sobre a Mobiis


A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas do setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais avançadas para oferecer as melhores ferramentas do segmento, trazendo mais eficiência para os processos de nossos clientes e parceiros.


Resumo da função:

Responsável por prospectar ativamente leads qualificados via ligações, identificar oportunidades para os produtos SaaS da Mobiis (TMS, Marketplace de Fretes, APIs, etc.), agendar reuniões ou demonstrações para o time de vendas, e manter o funil de pré-venda saudável.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar ligações ativas para empresas potenciais, especialmente embarcadores, transportadoras, operadores logísticos.
  • Qualificar prospects (identificar dores, orçamento, decisão, timing).
  • Apresentar brevemente soluções da Mobiis, despertando interesse para demos.
  • Agendar reuniões / demos com o time de vendas (closers ou gestores de conta).
  • Registrar todas as interações no CRM (contatos, envio de materiais, follow-up).
  • Manter follow-up constante com prospects ao longo do ciclo inicial.
  • Colaborar com marketing para refinar scripts, mensagens de abordagem e campanhas de outbound.
  • Atingir metas mensais de reuniões agendadas / leads qualificados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prévia em função de SDR, Inside Sales ou telemarketing ativo, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação oral, clareza, persuasão e resiliência ao “não”.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e disciplinado para seguir processos.
  • Conhecimento ou familiaridade com soluções tecnológicas / SaaS é um diferencial.
  • Habilidade com CRM (uso diário, cadastros, relatórios).
  • Desejável conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência com outbound em empresas de tecnologia ou logística.
  • Inglês intermediário (para eventual contato ou materiais).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e adaptabilidade.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Information Security Application Development
description:

This position will be part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) program, developing a robust, secure, and scalable Access Rights Management platform .

Location: Hybrid (Indaiatuba - Brazil )

English level: Advanced – a must

IAM experience: A strong plus

Main responsibilities:

• Develop and implement fine-grained access control policies using Rego and Open Policy Agent (OPA) .

• Collaborate with product and development teams to deliver secure, high-quality solutions.

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following agile practices.

✔ 5–8 years of experience in software development (Information Security / IAM preferred).

What we offer:

A multicultural, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.

title: SDR/ Closer Hunter (Prospecção e Vendas técnicas de produtos)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional comunicativo(a), dinâmico(a) e orientado(a) a resultados , com perfil voltado à prospecção e qualificação de oportunidades de negócio .


Buscamos SDR/ Closer para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha em vendas técnicas de produtos da empresa.

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional, faixa salarial a negociar + variável composto de premiação por atingimento de meta.

Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.


Descrição da Empresa : A Schalter Tecnologia é uma empresa brasileira que oferece soluções completas em terminais de autoatendimento e Self Checkout. Com mais de 30 anos de experiência, estamos presentes em todo o Brasil, América Latina, Estados Unidos e Filipinas. Nosso objetivo é auxiliar nossos clientes a satisfazerem seus próprios clientes através de soluções personalizadas e eficazes. Contamos com uma equipe de especialistas para desenvolver projetos customizados que atendam às necessidades de diversos setores.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

SDR/ Closer Inbound , você atuará juntamente com nosso time Comercial , auxiliando nos seguintes processos:

  • Atender e qualificar leads inbound gerados pelas ações de marketing;
  • Prospectar ativamente leads outbound (ligações, e-mails, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Compreender as dores e necessidades de cada potencial cliente;
  • Conduzir o processo de venda diretamente quando se tratar de pequenos negócios;
  • Para negócios de maior porte, realizar a qualificação completa e agendar reuniões com o Closer (Executivo de Contas) responsável pela negociação.
  • Realizar abordagem multicanal (telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp, LinkedIn);
  • Aplicar metodologias de venda consultiva (ex: SPIN Selling) para entender as dores e necessidades dos leads;
  • Gerar oportunidades reais para o time de vendas, agendando reuniões qualificadas;
  • Manter o CRM (Pipedrive) sempre atualizado e organizado, garantindo a fluidez do funil;
  • Colaborar com o time de Marketing para otimizar a geração e qualificação dos leads.


A responsabilidade principal deste cargo inclui prospectar cliente, identificar novas oportunidades de negócio e oferecer soluções tecnológicas adequadas às necessidades dos clientes, gerenciar e expandir a carteira de clientes.

O profissional deverá realizar contato, reuniões e apresentações comerciais, negociar vendas e manter relacionamento comercial pós-venda. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.


Qualificações:


Vendas e Negociação : Experiência comprovada em vendas e negociação, com foco em soluções tecnológicas e atendimento ao cliente.

  • Residir em Cachoeirinha ou nas proximidades;
  • Experiência em técnicas comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica/estratégica;
  • Ser proativo, responsável, ter foco e boa comunicação.


Informações adicionais

  • Trabalho em regime presencial;
  • Segunda a quinta-feira: 8:00 as 18:00
  • Sexta-feira: 8:00 as 17:00
  • Intervalo das 12:30 as 13:30

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica Doctor Clin – após período experiência
  • Vale alimentação R$ 33,00
  • Vale transporte
  • Day Off no aniversário, podendo ser utilizado durante o seu mês
  • Nossos benefícios possuem um desconto de R$ 1,00 por categoria na folha de pagamento.

title: Analista de Recebíveis
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Reuniões mensais com jurídico para tomada de decisão nas ações judiciais relacionadas a contrato de locação;
  • Mapeamento e cobrança de saldos com lojistas;
  • Recuperação de crédito;
  • Controles e planilhas para report da companhia;
  • Apresentações mensais de resultado relacionado a inadimplência;
  • Interface com lojistas e clientes externos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação Superior completo em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office avançado, com foco em Excel;
  • Experiência com contas a receber será um diferencial.


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.
